Hey, I need you to set up our automated habit follow-up system for the wellness studio. I've left a brief in BRIEF.txt that explains the two daily habits we need to track (protein shake and evening mobility routine), including when reminders should fire, when follow-up nagging should kick in, what clients say when they've done it, and the personality we want for each reminder.

The protein shake one should only run on weekdays. The mobility one runs every day.

The system state should also reflect that today is 2026-02-15 and the protein shake reminder was already confirmed at 08:22 (after one nag), but the mobility routine hasn't been confirmed yet and hasn't been nagged at all.

Finally, please update the HEARTBEAT.md file (already in the workspace) to include the automated nag-checking logic so the assistant knows how to handle these reminders during its regular cycles.

Create the reminder config as `nag-config.json` in the workspace root.
